dc_title_s: Countywide Aerial Imagery Mosaic for Dunn County, WI 2007
dc_description_s: This raster image data set presents a digital color ortho-rectified mosaic covering Dunn County, Wisconsin. The aerial photography was acquired June 2007 using an Intergraph DMC digital format camera.  The ortho mosaic was created by using aerial triangulation calculations and then rectifying against a digital terrain model.  The spatial coordinate system is NAD_1983_HARN_WISCRS_Dunn_County_Feet.
